_comment: SANITIZED shape of the successful `terraform show -json <refresh-only plan>`
export that root generated against the real platform backend with Terraform
1.14.9 and AWS provider 6.66.0 (issue #5831).
This is a SHAPE fixture, not real data. Every value is a placeholder: no
account number, ARN, resource id, bucket, variable value or attribute from
the real deployment appears here, and none may be added. The real export and
the real plan stay on root's host.
Why it exists: an earlier version of refresh_only_migration_guard.py refused
this document, reporting that it 'has no resource_changes key'. That key is
LEGITIMATELY ABSENT -- Terraform omits resource_changes from the JSON of a
plan that proposes no resource changes, which is exactly what a correct
refresh-only plan is. So the guard was refusing the very artifact it exists
to approve. This fixture pins the distinction the guard must now make:
an omitted optional field is a legitimate complete export; a malformed,
truncated, errored or incomplete document is not.
The top-level key set below is exactly the one root reported, in the same
order, with resource_changes absent. Do NOT add resource_changes to this
fixture to make a test pass -- that would recreate the defect by editing the
evidence instead of the guard.
Terraform never reads this file; it is test input only. The _comment key is
a literal string array and is not a real plan-export field.
